notes: family: dice-drafting-engine-scoring. Verified against the official rulebook v2 p.22: Studies (highest completed level per study), Patrons (per patron where you have a fox meeple), Upgrades (printed on unlocked upgrades), Friendliness track, plus 1 per point token, 1 per science card, 1 per 2 trait/friendly tokens combined. Tie: closest to the beginning of the supply track. Component-specific study, patron, upgrade and award values are scorer inputs. Base 2-4 players; solo AI, 2-player mode details and 5-6 expansion not modelled.

rounds.endCondition: Game ends after friendliness rewards of the 5th round are placed
